# Intervention workbench · S05

Connect explicit cause/effect hypotheses, name conditions, timing and rival explanations, then compare interventions by expected observations and bounded tests. Step order is layout only; directed feedback is allowed. Six intervention types remain optional prompts, not a ranking. The separate purpose from Reframing is designing a test that distinguishes causal explanations.

Drag step connectors to create links and interventions onto links to retarget them. Labelled buttons and selects offer the same actions; phone canvases pan normally outside handles. A changed problem, endpoint, relationship or test retains writing and flags context review. Review snapshots preserve the wording checked without claiming validation. Observations and their status survive changed claims with a review warning.

Branches retain flat source snapshots and reasons; parents with live descendants remain protected. Compare four alternatives, choose a test and record a decision. Existing route, storage key and portable version remain; earlier sequence arrows become blank suggested hypotheses, and earlier interventions retain their step attachments. No causal evidence or link attachment is inferred from order.

Start a dated test to freeze the chosen intervention, expectation, rival explanation and causal context. Each attempt retains that flat record if the source changes or is removed. Review results separately as actual observations, interpretation, a continue/revise/stop/undecided decision with reasons, and a next check. The review date cannot precede the start; recording a review saves its fields together. Closing the result form cancels unsaved changes. Reviews can be corrected, while the starting record stays fixed; a subsequent test creates another attempt. Earlier workspaces default to no attempts, without treating existing relationship observations as dated tests.

Local saving, grouped Undo, recovery and Markdown/JSON use workshop-kit. Limits: 7 steps, 18 directed relationships, 24 interventions, 100 test attempts, 100 workspaces; portable workspace size is guarded before mutation. Tests cover migration, feedback and reference integrity, contextual review, frozen sources and test attempts, atomic rejection, Undo and multibyte exports.
